headline: Tupac goes off on Mobb Deep in an interview with Angie Martinez that sat unreleased for 30
body: Tupac goes off on Mobb Deep in an interview with Angie Martinez that sat unreleased for 30 years He calls them "little babies" while addressing the beef head on. The full conversation is part of The Tupac Tapes with Angie Martinez, a four-episode video podcast now on Netflix. Follow for hip-hop news every day. tupac mobbdeep angiemartinez hiphopnews rapnews.
